LanguageData.Projectile_ArcsRay.description: A piercing arrow of light conjured by the Arcs Ray spell. It tracks its target and passes through enemies and buildings along its path
LanguageData.Projectile_ArcsRay.label: Light Arrow
LanguageData.Projectile_KingsSword.description: A hovering greatsword summoned by the King's Sword spell. It circles the caster and attacks nearby enemies on its own
LanguageData.Projectile_KingsSword.label: King's Sword
LanguageData.Projectile_LightOrb.description: A light orb summoned by the Guardian Light Spirits spell. It circles the caster, absorbing incoming projectiles and burning nearby enemies
LanguageData.Projectile_LightOrb.label: Light Spirit
LanguageData.Projectile_WindMissile.description: A wind bolt conjured by the Luminous Wind spell. It can track enemies, or be detonated for area damage
LanguageData.Projectile_WindMissile.label: Wind Bolt
